description.value: Palmyra Mediterranean Grill is a family-owned halal restaurant operating since 2013, serving shawarma, kabobs, falafel, and other Middle Eastern dishes made with local and seasonal ingredients. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, as well as delivery through Uber Eats and DoorDash. Touring cyclists will find a full menu of hearty, protein-rich plates and several plant-based options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully retrieved from cache despite front_fetch_failed status. The website confirms a real, operating Mediterranean restaurant with dine-in and takeout, at 10020, 152 St, Surrey, BC V3R 8X8 — however, the OSM record is categorized under 'North Vancouver' while the coordinates (49.1845, -122.8005) and website address both point to Surrey, indicating a community mis-assignment. Vegetarian items (falafel, hummus, baba ghanouj, tabouli, fatoush salad) are clearly listed on the menu; bike-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community is listed as 'North Vancouver' but the website address (10020, 152 St, Surrey, BC V3R 8X8) and coordinates (49.1845, -122.8005) both place this business firmly in Surrey, not North Vancouver. The record may be mis-assigned to the wrong community in the directory.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website and could not be cross-confirmed against OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with a confirmed website, address, and phone number. Offers dine-in and takeout suitable for cycling tourists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: Falafel (fried chickpeas), Baba Ghanouj, Hummus, Tabouli, Fatoush Salad, and Batata wrap (fries, coleslaw, garlic sauce). No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
